title: SR-1.33 A test count that means behaviour
request: Closes G99: the seed-stage analysis (E1, E8). About a fifth of the test files read documents rather than run code: on main 5e1a1e05, 25 of 165 test files import nothing from src/ or bin/ and start no memev process, so the pass count overstates what is tested. The lab walk of every command (scripts/lab/cli-walk.sh) compares each command's exit code with an expected one that has gone stale, and nothing runs it. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: QL-1.02.

tasks.title: Behaviour tests and document checks counted apart
requirements: a test file that only reads documents (it imports nothing from src/ or bin/ and starts no memev process) lives under test/docs/; every other test file exercises code
npm test runs both and prints two lines, behaviour tests: N pass, M fail and document checks: N pass, M fail; CI's job summary shows both

scripts/test-kinds.mjs, run by npm test, fails naming the file when a test file outside test/docs/ neither imports from src/ or bin/ nor starts a memev process, or when a file under test/docs/ does either
wherever the README or docs/DEVELOPING.md give a test count, it is the behaviour count

criteria.statement: SR-1.33 kinds: a fixture test file outside test/docs/ that only reads a Markdown file fails scripts/test-kinds.mjs naming it; a fixture under test/docs/ that imports src/engine/vault.mjs fails it too; the real tree passes

verifier.cmd: out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^SR-1.33 kinds' test/test-kinds.test.mjs 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -30; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v pat='^SR-1.33 kinds$' 'BEGIN { n = split(pat, alt, "|") } function flush(  i) { if (cand != "") for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (cand ~ alt[i]) hit[i] = 1; cand = "" } /^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - / { flush(); name = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - /, "", name); if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*ok / && name !~ /# (SKIP|TODO)/ && name !~ /\.test\.m?js$/) cand = name; next } /^[[:space:]]*type: .suite./ { cand = "" } END { flush(); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!hit[i]) exit 1; exit 0 }'

criteria.statement: The real test tree passes the kinds check
npm test prints the behaviour and document counts apart, each with no failure

verifier.cmd: out=$(MEMEV_NO_SERVICE=1 HOME="$(mktemp -d)" npm test 2>&1); printf "%s" "$out" | grep -qE "behaviour tests: [0-9]+ pass, 0 fail" && printf "%s" "$out" | grep -qE "document checks: [0-9]+ pass, 0 fail"
